description: The sidewalk on both sides appears continuous and paved, but it is relatively narrow and separated from traffic by a low metal fence/guardrail; curb lines are visible, though specific curb cuts or ramps are not clearly shown. Traffic is in multiple lanes with overhead signals and streetlights, and there is some greenery along the corridor providing partial shade, but the roadway is wide and speeds may be higher due to the open, barrier-separated design. Obstacles include parked vehicles and street furniture near the curb, and lighting is provided by tall streetlights along the roadway.
